ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ratio featuring a dominant high-intensity white ventral field (approx. 85% of surface) bordered by a low-intensity black trailing edge and scattered black focal spots (approx. 15% of surface).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Centralized contiguous white field; low-intensity black banding along the entire trailing edge; distinct black circular focal points (spots) distributed bilaterally on both lobes; yellowish-tan pigmentation clusters located in the proximal region near the water line.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression at the center-line with a steep pixel gradient and deep penetration into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-to-medium amplitude irregular serrations forming a jagged boundary along the entire trailing edge from the notch to the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curvature extending from the central notch towards the distal tips, characterized by a smooth upward and outward arc.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast, irregular textured clusters localized on the distal tips of both lobes; several small, dark, circular pixel-clusters scattered across the interior white surface of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, multiple parallel gray linear streaks (rake marks) oriented horizontally/diagonally across the mid-section of both fluke lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy biological encrustation and rugose texture at the extreme lateral tips of the fluke, consistent with barnacle colonization.
other_distinctive_markers: Visible yellowish-brown staining (diatom film) forming asymmetrical blobs in the lower central region where the fluke emerges from the water.
